outcome_definition: CALL AGREEMENT, not a mismatch effect: TP/FP/FN/TN of an allele-specific RPA reaction against  Sanger sequencing . Sensitivity = TP/(TP+FN), specificity = TN/(TN+FP). Every assay here is designed so that the discriminating primer carries a deliberately placed mismatch; the paper reports the resulting call rate, NOT the log-odds cost of any single mismatch position. Do not use these rows to weight a mismatch; use rpa_mismatch_terminal.csv for that.
